# Robot simulation descriptions (URDF, SRDF, SDF)

Curated by Skill Harbor — @earthtojake's robot-simulation skill: author and validate robot descriptions for ROS, MoveIt and Gazebo — a URDF for the robot's structure (links, joints, geometry, inertials, limits, transmissions), an SRDF beside it for MoveIt's planning semantics (planning groups, end effectors, group states, disabled collision pairs), and an SDF for Gazebo models and worlds (sensors, plugins, physics). Every file starts with a design ledger, SI units throughout, spatial transforms never guessed, computed numbers never freehanded, and each change checked with cad urdf validate, cad srdf validate or cad sdf validate, then reviewed with a snapshot in the CAD Viewer. Honest caveats: a clean check is a guardrail, not proof — it cannot show that a joint origin or axis matches the real robot; an SDF for a robot that already has a URDF is derived from it, never re-authored; listed here with credit to its creator; MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
